from typing import List

class Solution:
    def minimumDistance(self, points: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(points)
        s = [x + y for x, y in points]
        d = [x - y for x, y in points]

        s_desc = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: -s[i])[:3]
        s_asc = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: s[i])[:3]
        d_desc = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: -d[i])[:3]
        d_asc = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: d[i])[:3]

        ans = float('inf')
        for i in range(n):
            max_s = next(s[j] for j in s_desc if j != i)
            min_s = next(s[j] for j in s_asc if j != i)
            max_d = next(d[j] for j in d_desc if j != i)
            min_d = next(d[j] for j in d_asc if j != i)
            cur = max(max_s - min_s, max_d - min_d)
            if cur < ans:
                ans = cur
        return ans

class Solution:
    def minimumDistance(self, points: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(points)
        u = [x + y for x, y in points]
        v = [x - y for x, y in points]

        candidates = set()
        candidates.add(max(range(n), key=lambda i: u[i]))
        candidates.add(min(range(n), key=lambda i: u[i]))
        candidates.add(max(range(n), key=lambda i: v[i]))
        candidates.add(min(range(n), key=lambda i: v[i]))

        best = float('inf')
        for c in candidates:
            mxu = mnu = None
            mxv = mnv = None
            for i in range(n):
                if i == c:
                    continue
                a = u[i]
                b = v[i]
                if mxu is None:
                    mxu = mnu = a
                    mxv = mnv = b
                else:
                    if a > mxu:
                        mxu = a
                    if a < mnu:
                        mnu = a
                    if b > mxv:
                        mxv = b
                    if b < mnv:
                        mnv = b
            d = max(mxu - mnu, mxv - mnv)
            if d < best:
                best = d
        return best

class Solution:
    def minimumDistance(self, points: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(points)
        us = [p[0] + p[1] for p in points]
        vs = [p[0] - p[1] for p in points]

        iu = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: us[i])
        iv = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: vs[i])

        # Smallest and largest two indices for u and v
        minU = [iu[0], iu[1]]
        maxU = [iu[-1], iu[-2]]
        minV = [iv[0], iv[1]]
        maxV = [iv[-1], iv[-2]]

        best = float('inf')
        for i in range(n):
            # max/min u excluding i
            mx_u_idx = maxU[0] if maxU[0] != i else maxU[1]
            mn_u_idx = minU[0] if minU[0] != i else minU[1]
            mx_v_idx = maxV[0] if maxV[0] != i else maxV[1]
            mn_v_idx = minV[0] if minV[0] != i else minV[1]

            du = us[mx_u_idx] - us[mn_u_idx]
            dv = vs[mx_v_idx] - vs[mn_v_idx]
            cur = du if du > dv else dv
            if cur < best:
                best = cur
        return best

class Solution:
    def minimumDistance(self, points: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(points)
        u = [x + y for x, y in points]
        v = [x - y for x, y in points]

        order_u = sorted(range(n), key=u.__getitem__)
        order_v = sorted(range(n), key=v.__getitem__)

        candidates = set(order_u[:2] + order_u[-2:] + order_v[:2] + order_v[-2:])

        best = float('inf')
        for i in candidates:
            mnu = float('inf')
            mxu = float('-inf')
            mnv = float('inf')
            mxv = float('-inf')
            for j in range(n):
                if j == i:
                    continue
                a = u[j]
                b = v[j]
                if a < mnu:
                    mnu = a
                if a > mxu:
                    mxu = a
                if b < mnv:
                    mnv = b
                if b > mxv:
                    mxv = b
            cur = max(mxu - mnu, mxv - mnv)
            if cur < best:
                best = cur

        return int(best)
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def minimumDistance(self, points: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(points)
        u = [x + y for x, y in points]
        v = [x - y for x, y in points]
        ou = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: u[i])
        ov = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: v[i])

        candidates = set()
        for k in range(min(2, n)):
            candidates.add(ou[k])
            candidates.add(ou[n - 1 - k])
            candidates.add(ov[k])
            candidates.add(ov[n - 1 - k])

        def extremes(order, val, r):
            # min and max of val over order skipping index r
            mn = None
            for i in order:
                if i != r:
                    mn = val[i]
                    break
            mx = None
            for i in reversed(order):
                if i != r:
                    mx = val[i]
                    break
            return mn, mx

        best = None
        for r in candidates:
            umn, umx = extremes(ou, u, r)
            vmn, vmx = extremes(ov, v, r)
            d = max(umx - umn, vmx - vmn)
            if best is None or d < best:
                best = d
        return best
